description: The Quick Access window (spec 2026-10-13-quick-access-design §4): read the lock state, unlock, search logins, copy a password, username or one-time code (Rust writes the clipboard), open a login's saved website, report activity, hide itself, and listen for events. Nothing that edits, reveals, exports, changes settings, or touches the account, pairing or passkeys; no plugin commands, no filesystem, no shell, no network.
